records.title: A Tree doorway Nanoswarm trap
records.description: Place two Nanoswarms across the A Tree approach to the rotating door, one on each side of the passage. Keep the Alarmbot between their damage zones and hold from cover. When it detects an attacker committing through Tree, activate the Nanoswarms to cover the corridor; keep an escape route clear of your own damage. The linked demonstration shows the placement and overlapping coverage.

source.author: Briiest
source.evidence: Primary watch-page player metadata status OK/playableInEmbed=true. Actual frames at2:08 and2:23 show placement in A Tree and two activated Nanoswarms covering the rotating-door corridor; HUD sourceversion12.06.00.4440219. Source is after Lotus12.05 rework. Relevant local Tree corridor/floor placements do not rely on changed A Lobby/Vines/stairs/plant zone. Reviewed later Riot12.09,12.10,12.11,13.00,13.01,13.05,13.06,13.08 notes; no relevant Nanoswarm trajectory/localgeometry change identified.13.00 buffs Nanoswarm duration4to5seconds, so no old duration is copied. Compatibility inferred from unchanged relevant geometry and demonstrated floor placement; no independent gameplay test.

records.title: A Short teleporter approach Nanoswarm trap
records.description: Place one Nanoswarm beside the small wooden box at the foot of the A Short steps, then place the second farther up the passage beside the wall. Add an Alarmbot between the two damage zones. Hold from site cover and activate on attackers committing past the teleporter; use the linked overhead view to match the spacing.

source.author: Briiest
source.evidence: Actual source frames inspected around2:06,2:21,2:31 and2:36: A Short teleporter, wooden box, two Nanoswarm markers and Alarmbot radius. Source HUD12.02. Patch12.04 mentions nonspecific gap adjustments on multiple maps; this setup uses exposed floor surfaces, not a gap/through-wall exploit. This remains an explicit compatibility uncertainty. Reviewed official Riot patch notes from the source release through 13.08. Compatibility is an inference from the demonstrated ordinary floor placements and absence of an identified change to their relevant local geometry, not an independent gameplay test. Patch13.00 increases Nanoswarm duration and Alarmbot speed; no old duration or guaranteed trigger timing is copied.

records.title: A Garden Main-exit Nanoswarm trap
records.description: Place two Nanoswarms across the A Garden path in front of Main, between the square rock and the curved pavilion wall, with the Alarmbot between them. Match the open approach shown in the overhead view. Keep devices clear of moving wall or door tracks, and activate as attackers commit into Garden; a changed doorway state can change which route they take.

source.author: Briiest
source.evidence: Actual source frames at3:01 and3:11 show A Garden floor placement and overhead layout: two Nanoswarms and central Alarmbot on the open path between tall square rock and curved pavilion wall. Source caption identifies area in front of Main. Uses open approach state, not a throw through a droppable wall. Riot13.01 fixes Iso/Waylay wall exploits;13.02 fixes utility crushed by already-closed Summit door;13.08 adjusts Alarmbot destruction feedback at moving doorways. Placements accepted only with explicit clearance from moving tracks and matching open approach; no claim of safety while a wall moves. Reviewed official Riot patch notes from the source release through 13.08. Compatibility is an inference from the demonstrated ordinary floor placements and absence of an identified change to their relevant local geometry, not an independent gameplay test. Patch13.00 increases Nanoswarm duration and Alarmbot speed; no old duration or guaranteed trigger timing is copied.

records.title: B Site central-box Nanoswarm trap
records.description: Place two Nanoswarms on the B Site floor around the central teal-and-gray boxes: one toward the roofed B entrance and the other on the opposite side of the boxes. Add an Alarmbot in the path between the entrance and the first swarm. Activate as attackers commit onto site. Match the open doorway shown in the overhead view and keep every device outside moving door tracks.

source.author: Briiest
source.evidence: Actual source frames at4:40,4:50,5:00 and5:05 show B Site floor placements, a Nanoswarm marker and then two overlapping activated damage areas around the central teal/gray boxes next to the roofed B doorway. The chapter242 label includes a preceding A variant, so link starts at278 inside the actual B segment. Source is post-Summit release13.00. Later Riot13.01 changes Iso/Waylay exploits,13.02 fixes utility crushed by already-closed Summit doors, and13.08 adds Alarmbot destruction feedback at moving doorways. Accepted only for the shown open approach with placements clear of moving tracks. Relevant site floor geometry has no identified subsequent change. Compatibility inferred, not independently gameplay tested.
